svg.text: PROACT Evaluation Board — System Architecture & Signal Routing
Each interface jumper is a 2:1 selector: drive the PROACT pin from the on-board USB bridge module OR from the ChipWhisperer CW308.
UART · SPI/GPIO · nRST · CW clk J7.3 · clk echo J7.5
shunt J8.2/J8.3 · filter J8.5/6/8 · TRIG in
LED1 = SPI_RST · LED2 = CRST · LED3 = GRST
D2 · D4–D6 debug taps (yellow) · D3 spare_io (orange)

link 5-6 · CW clock via J7.3 + R8
• fit exactly ONE J12 source link — 1-2 · 3-4 · 5-6
• leave CW308 J3 unpopulated — it drives J7.5 (clock echo) and would fight the source
CW308 reads ΔV across R7 (J8.3 SHUNTH / J8.2 SHUNTL) → power trace
die-side Vcore net is capacitor-free → shunt sees instantaneous die current
SET 0.8 V BEFORE INSERTING THE CHIP
